name: ULTRA-LOW DRY CABINET
desc: Premium Microprocessor-Controlled Ultra-Low Humidity Dry Storage Cabinet engineered for safe preservation of moisture-sensitive devices. Features an auto-regenerated electronic Zeolite desiccant dehumidifier maintaining an ultra-low humidity range from 1% to 50% RH.
features: Wide precision moisture regulation spanning from 1% to 50% RH
Rapid 30-minute recovery time to below 5% RH level after door opening
Auto-Regenerated electronic desiccant system utilizing premium Zeolite
Heavy-gauge cold-rolled steel sheet with anti-static ESD-safe paint
Fully automated plug-and-play tracking adjusting RH upon system startup

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Fast-Dry Ultra-Low Humidity Storage Cabinet
specifications.Internal Dimensions (W x D x H): 898 mm x 572 mm x 848 mm optimized internal space layout
specifications.Overall Dimensions (W x D x H): 900 mm x 600 mm x 1010 mm compact structural footprint
specifications.Storage Infrastructure: 3 Pieces heavy-duty adjustable storage shelves included
specifications.Humidity Control Range: Wide precision moisture regulation spanning from 1% to 50% RH
specifications.Primary Dehumidifier Type: Auto-Regenerated electronic desiccant system utilizing premium Zeolite
specifications.Operational Automation: Fully automated plug-and-play tracking adjusting RH upon system startup
specifications.Chamber Micro-Climate Recovery: Rapid 30-minute recovery time to below 5% RH level after a 30-second door opening
specifications.Display Tracking Precision: High-accuracy instrumentation index at ±3.0% RH and ±1.0°C margins
specifications.Chassis Structural Build: 1 mm thick heavy-gauge cold-rolled steel sheet with anti-static paint finish
specifications.Door Assembly Architecture: Independent door handles fitted with secure individual Lock and Key sets
specifications.Chamber Sealing Integrity: Heavy-duty airtight magnetic rubber gasket continuous door seal
specifications.Process Inspection Panel: Multi-pane clear toughened transparent glass viewing windows
specifications.Equipment Mobility Support: Base-mounted heavy-duty Caster Wheels integrated with structural safety brakes
specifications.Power Supply Requirements: Standard 220 Volts, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable Indian plug configuration
specifications.Supported System Upgrades: Provision for N2 flow meter, Data logger with USB port, and Door open alarms
specifications.Optional Structural Add-ons: Supports overall Stainless Steel 304 construction and ESD wrist strap bands
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty on full electronic desiccant block
